scope_rule: Review every visual-challenge pair with |lexical_delta| > 0.1 or a new target-linked rejection, plus every insufficient-context pair where native lexical score exceeds intervention by more than 0.1.
semantic_rule: Compare both action responses with all official reference variants. Lexical shortening alone is a tie; an answer changes action utility only when semantic correctness changes.

remaining_pool_stratified_audit.sampling_rule: 20 evenly spaced rows from the 208 pairs outside the primary audit scope after sorting by HaloQuest ID.
remaining_pool_stratified_audit.note: Several ties are jointly wrong; no sampled pair shows a clear intervention harm.

limitations: This is an AI semantic audit, not human annotation and not official HaloQuest Auto-Eval.
The primary scope is deliberately enriched for potential action changes and does not estimate population effect prevalence.
Only 20 of the 208 pairs outside the primary scope were reviewed.
The audit uses official textual references without re-inspecting every source image.
